lin.limitations: Open Lingala-French kit; the source does not establish specifically DRC-only variety or geographic provenance.

ktu.limitations: SMOL explicitly labels the configuration Kituba (DRC); retain the source's documented translation-quality warning.

lua.limitations: Gated english-tshiluba configuration; licence is listed as other, and DRC-specific provenance and redistribution rights remain unresolved.

swc.limitations: Downloadable Congo Swahili-French kits; attribution to CLEAR Global is required.

tll.limitations: The wrapper labels the data as DRC and CC BY 4.0, but mixes upstream OPUS domains; cite both the wrapper and OPUS MT560 guidance.

alz.limitations: The wrapper labels the data as DRC, but Alur is cross-border with Uganda and the corpus does not establish a DRC-specific variety; upstream OPUS provenance is mixed.

nnb.limitations: Open Nande-French kits with required CLEAR Global attribution; Nande is cross-border with Uganda and the kit does not establish DRC-only provenance.

lgm.limitations: The exact Lega-Mwenga edition is marked copyrighted. Only metadata and preparation scripts may be published; corpus text remains excluded.

zne.limitations: The exact Zande edition is copyrighted and labelled for DRC, Central African Republic, and South Sudan. Only metadata and scripts may be published.

ngc.limitations: Three exact Ngombe editions are marked public domain, while the aggregate dataset card uses licence other. The religious corpus is labelled for DRC and Central African Republic.

lub.limitations: The wrapper labels Luba-Katanga data as DRC and CC BY 4.0, but mixes upstream OPUS domains; cite both the wrapper and OPUS MT560 guidance.

lej.limitations: The 23-book Lengola collection and English reference are CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution and ShareAlike requirements must be retained.

yns.limitations: The exact Yansi edition and French reference are marked public domain, while the aggregate dataset card uses licence other; preserve edition and package attribution.

auh.limitations: The CC BY-SA Aushi sources are explicitly Zambian. They establish open Aushi data, not a DRC-specific edition; actual downloaded coverage is four books rather than the product page's full-Bible label.

bem.limitations: The wrapper explicitly labels the Bemba data as Zambia. It does not establish DRC-specific coverage, and mixed upstream OPUS provenance remains documented.

kon.limitations: The gated english-kikongo configuration uses the collective Kongo label without row-level country or subvariety provenance. Licence is listed as other; it must remain distinct from Kituba and specific Koongo varieties.

lun.limitations: The wrapper explicitly labels the Lunda data as Zambia. It does not establish DRC-specific coverage, and mixed upstream OPUS provenance remains documented.

yaf.limitations: The exact Yaka edition is marked public domain and labelled for both DRC and Angola, while the aggregate dataset card uses licence other; do not describe it as DRC-exclusive.

bmb.limitations: Matching official Kibembe and French EPUBs support deterministic paragraph alignment, but the copyrighted publication grants no redistribution permission. Text remains local and excluded.

buu.limitations: Both exact Budu editions are marked copyrighted and DRC-labelled. Only metadata and preparation scripts may be published; aligned text remains excluded.

flr.limitations: The complete Fuliiru edition is all rights reserved. Fuliiru is cross-border with Burundi and the edition does not establish DRC-specific provenance; text remains local and excluded.

hke.limitations: The official copyrighted Hunde edition exposes only Mark, Luke, and John despite its New Testament title. No corpus redistribution licence is granted; text remains local and excluded.

hoo.limitations: The copyrighted official edition provides 45 chapters but does not identify a narrower Holoholo subvariety or establish DRC-specific provenance. Text remains local and excluded.

keo.limitations: The exact copyrighted Kakwa edition is labelled for DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda. Only metadata and scripts may be published; aligned text remains excluded.

khy.limitations: The exact Kele/Lokele edition is copyrighted, DRC-labelled, and published by the Bible Society of the DRC. Text remains local and excluded.

kmw.limitations: The exact Komo edition is copyrighted and DRC-labelled. Only metadata and scripts may be published; aligned text remains excluded.

kny.limitations: The official Kanyok site exposes six verse-keyed books but grants no corpus redistribution licence. Derived text remains local and excluded.

lea.limitations: The complete official Lega-Shabunda edition is copyrighted and DRC-labelled. It remains distinct from Lega-Mwenga; aligned text stays local and excluded.

log.limitations: Both exact Logo editions are copyrighted and labelled for DRC and South Sudan. Only metadata and scripts may be published; aligned text remains excluded.

lol.limitations: Both exact Mongo/Nkundo editions are copyrighted and DRC-labelled. Only metadata and scripts may be published; aligned text remains excluded.

loq.limitations: The exact Lobala edition is copyrighted and labelled for both DRC and the Republic of the Congo. Only metadata and scripts may be published; aligned text remains excluded.

mdm.limitations: The exact Mayogo edition is copyrighted and DRC-labelled. Only metadata and scripts may be published; aligned text remains excluded.

ndp.limitations: The exact Ndo/Kebu edition is copyrighted and labelled for DRC and Uganda. Only metadata and scripts may be published; aligned text remains excluded.

hav.limitations: The DRC-labelled Havu edition permits redistribution and adaptation under CC BY-SA 4.0; retain attribution, change notices, and ShareAlike terms.

loo.limitations: The selected Lombo Mark and Luke documents are DRC-labelled and reusable under CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution and ShareAlike requirements must be retained.

rnd.limitations: The wrapper labels this cross-border language's data as DRC and CC BY 4.0, but mixes upstream OPUS domains; cite both the wrapper and OPUS MT560 guidance.

shr.limitations: The selected Mashi/Shi edition is explicitly DRC-labelled and reusable under CC BY 4.0; preserve attribution and identify modifications.

sop.limitations: The wrapper labels the Songe data as DRC and CC BY 4.0, but mixes upstream OPUS domains; cite both the wrapper and OPUS MT560 guidance.
